articles.title: 5,300-Year-Old Iceman Has Living Microbes on His Body!
articles.summary: Scientists found tiny yeast on Ötzi the Iceman that can still grow in a lab. The 5,300-year-old mummy was found in the Alps. These microbes could damage his body, so researchers want to stop them.

articles.title: The Universe Can Expand Faster Than Light—Here's How!
articles.summary: The universe is 13.77 billion years old, but we can see 45 billion light-years away. That's because space itself expands faster than light. Don't worry, it doesn't break Einstein's rules!

articles.title: Astronaut Michael Foale Recalls the Scary Space Station Crash of 1997
articles.summary: In 1997, a cargo ship crashed into the Mir space station, tearing a hole and causing an air leak. Astronaut Michael Foale and his crew had only 23 minutes of oxygen left to fix it. He shares the thrilling story.
